text: しょうひんに　これを　プレゼント　しよう！

structure.jp: これを　プレゼント　しよう！

patterns.name: 〜に (as)
patterns.explanation: に after a thing here says what role it plays: 'as' that thing. しょうひんに = 'as a prize'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.span: プレゼント　しよう
patterns.explanation: The よう ending shows the speaker has decided to do it: 'I'll do it' or 'let's do it'. プレゼント　しよう = 'I'll give it as a gift'.
